name: 毒毒ちぃの👾定期朗読配信毎週土曜or日曜0時〜
description: はろー！世界のちぃず達！毒毒ちぃのだよ！ドラピオンとエルフーンが好き！セルフ受肉、ゲーム、ラジオ、朗読とか色々やってるよ！ファンネーム▶ちぃず◀ 固定読んでね！https://skeb.jp/@dkdk_chiino

works.body:
Good evening, my name is Hakuyu.

I'd like to ask Chiino to draw a picture for my song I'll give in March.
I hope you can draw a picture for the video I'm going to make in March.

The name of the song is "Haru wo Kakeru".
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DC6JppqHkaM
I'd like to ask you to draw the illustration of the thumbnail of the original song.
I'd like you to draw a picture of the thumbnail of the original.

I'm not sure if you can do it, but I'm sure you can.

The market price of a single picture with a bust-up background
I think it's about this much, and I'm raising the price.
If it is not enough, please tell me. ！！！！

Thank you very much!

https://www.dropbox.com/sh/gifxuu3wzitub3e/AAC4lNqiVTu5qPTo2w3VRQ3ta?dl=0
